issue_request: FHIR-17190 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I STU3 change request asking for `[Resource]/[id]/$validate` to validate an existing resource against the `profile` parameter by adding another mode where the `resource` parameter SHALL NOT be present.

additional_context: Later Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue FHIR-41357 revisited the same Resource.$validate target/resource/profile/mode matrix and intentionally relaxed the resource parameter rule for instance-level invocation, removed the profile-mode id-only parenthetical, clarified profile parameter behavior, and requested the current summary table. FHIR-41357 and FHIR-44864 are already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-37998 remains unresolved background.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current code system includes mode `profile`, the operation definition documents profile as required for mode=profile, and the summary table allows instance-level Existing Content/By Profile without a resource parameter; restoring the original SHALL-NOT-present wording would conflict with the later FHIR-41357 decision.
